items.text: Add KeyRotation DHT entry type (human/new/superseded pubkeys, recovery_request_hash, authority: RecoveryAuthority, rotated_at)
RecoveryAuthority enum with 5 variants: IntimateQuorum + CryptographicQuorum IMPLEMENTED; CommunityConsensus/GovernanceAct/NetworkWitness stub-rejected
validate_key_rotation rules 1-7: request resolves, pubkeys match, no-op guard, superseded is current agent, freeze-floor baseline, implemented-variant gate, variant-specific checks
Modernize RecoveryRequest struct: AgentPubKey-based with proposed_authority discriminator + request_nonce; replace legacy String-id fields wholesale

Link types: keep HumanToCurrentAgent/KeyRotationSupersededBy/AgentToKeyRotation; delete SeedCommitment links; add RecoveryRequestToHumanityWitness + RecoveryRequestToKeyStewardship; rename to HumanToRecoveryRequest
M1-cleanup: delete RecoverySeedCommitment/HeldRecoveryShare/MyRecoveryAuthorization entry types + link types + storage projections + views + JSON schemas + contract tests
M2: IntimateQuorum + CryptographicQuorum happy paths in validator; stub-reject other three; IdentityFreeze.frozen_at_layer halts same-or-lower-layer rotations

M3: coordinator fns create_recovery_request / commit_key_rotation (freeze-floor pre-commit gate via get_links) / submit_intimate_witness + post-commit signals + doorway libp2p invitation on recovery.invitation.{request_hash}
M4: fast-path revocation flows (self-revoke, contact-vote via RevocationVote, atomic-with-rotation) on existing KeyRevocation

M5: defender specialist manifest + elohim-agent rule 4; anomaly->freeze->counter-challenge; disclosure-tier hooks; frontend RecoveryCoordinatorService endpoints + holder prompt UI + defender-visible status + hosted-cell handoff
M6: anti-lockout audit + red-team scenario suite in genesis/a2o/features/auth/recovery/anti-lockout/; every failure mode has a community-mediated restoration path; shem cross-node full acceptance

Defender specialist manifest (imagodei-defender-specialist): triggers, input context, output permissions (may author IdentityAnomaly/Freeze/self-HumanityWitness/Challenge; MAY NOT author KeyRotation/KeyRevocation), disclosure tier
Dissolution stub: NetworkWitnessPurpose::Dissolution variant defined; validator rejects with reserved-for-constitutional-governance message; cradle-to-grave shape reserved
Anti-lockout audit gate: 12 scenarios, (1-6,9-12) get gherkin features, (7,8) get design-doc entries; audit FAILS if any new feature introduces a failure mode without a restoration path
Deferred variants flows: CommunityConsensus (Phase 2b intimacy-weighted challenge UX), GovernanceAct (qahal/mishpat cross-DNA resolution), NetworkWitness (elohim constitutional governance design)
